alt: Three finished relief carvings displayed on a craft fair table with a linen cloth, small easels and blank kraft price tags
scene: CRAFT FAIR TABLE, wide magazine shot. Three finished panels in the house finish stand on small wooden easels on a table covered in natural linen: the buck from image 1, the eagle scene from image 2 and the wolf from image 3, each exactly its own design. Each has a small plain kraft-paper tag on a string hanging from its easel, the tags BLANK with no writing. A folded stack of kraft gift boxes and a small wooden bowl of business-card-sized blank cards sit at one end. Soft daylight under a white canopy, other stalls softly out of focus behind. No people.

alt: A finished wolf relief packed in a kraft box with tissue paper, a blank card and a sawtooth hanger fitted on the back
scene: PACKING SHOT from above. The panel from image 1, in the house finish, lies face up in an open kraft box on ivory tissue paper. Beside it on the bench: a small blank cream card, a strip of undyed linen ribbon, and a second identical panel turned FACE DOWN showing its plain oiled back with a small brass sawtooth picture hanger fitted at the top centre and two felt bumpers at the bottom corners. Bright soft light, clean composition, nothing written anywhere.

alt: A finished eagle relief being photographed on a plain background with a single lamp raking across it from the side
scene: PRODUCT PHOTOGRAPHY SETUP, seen from behind the camera's shoulder. THE SUBJECT IS THE CARVED EAGLE MOUNTAIN SCENE FROM IMAGE 1, reproduced exactly (a soaring eagle over mountains and pines), finished in warm satin cherry with the recesses antiqued dark brown so the relief reads, standing on a plain pale grey seamless background on the bench. To the LEFT a single small plain black LED work lamp on a stand rakes light across the panel at a low angle so every carved edge throws a shadow; a white foam board on the right bounces light back. In the near foreground, slightly out of focus, the back of a plain matte-black camera on a tripod with ABSOLUTELY NO brand name, logo, lettering or badge anywhere on it or the lens. The carving is tack sharp. No text anywhere in the image.
